mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 3.5% year-over-year indicates persistent inflation, triggering Fed rate-hike expectations that depress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 70% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE indicates a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in at least 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a monthly decline in HOUST signals weakening housing demand, which precedes reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle periods with declining HOUST, or the signal's predictive power vanishes in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO index indicates robust industrial output growth, supporting corporate earnings momentum and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend fails to predict positive 20-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or returns are negative in 60%+ of high INDPRO periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year decline in RSAFS exceeding 1.0% signals deteriorating consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with RSAFS < -1.0% y/y, or the signal's predictive power drops below 0.03 Rank IC.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above 3.0% signal aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to produce negative 5-day returns in at least 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), a further decline in unemployment signals wage inflation pressures that prompt Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0%, or the signal's predictive power vanishes in 3-year rolling windows.
